newsitem.title: TANZANIA: Rwanda tribunal says genocide trial starts Friday.
newsitem.headline: Rwanda tribunal says genocide trial starts Friday.

text.p: A U.N. tribunal decided on Thursday to start on Friday its first joint trial of two Rwandans accused of genocide and crimes against humanity in 1994.
The International Criminal Tribunal for Rwanda in Arusha, Tanzania, ordered the prosecution to revise indictments for Clement Kayishema and Obed Ruzindana and have them ready by Friday.
The prosecution had applied for a delay for the indictments for both men to be consolidated while defence lawyers for the accused said they were ready to start as originally planned on Tuesday.
Kayishema and Ruzindana are both charged with five counts of genocide and crimes against humanity. They pleaded not guilty.
Both are accused of organising and involvement in massacres in western Rwanda during the 1994 genocide of an estimated 800,000 minority Tutsis and moderate Hutus by troops, militiamen and mobs.
